comment: Ingestion file for the Seoul hotel-comparison itineraries. Each entry below is one of the 8 Seoul hotels already researched in data/collections/hotels.json. Set "consider": true for the hotels the travel partner is actually deciding between — the build script then spreads the 20 itinerary themes across exactly those hotels. Add a "why" note so the generated plans can speak to her reasons.
